enquiries.$comment: §27 to §34. Prepared only after the public review was exhausted.
enquiries.two_packets_because: §29. R1 is a technical contract question suited to the provider's public issue tracker; R2 is a Terms question and the Terms themselves designate legal@globalping.io.
